notes: Overlapping ticks could press the same slot twice; they can't now. Timer errors are caught instead of crashing DungeonHelper, and process handles are no longer leaked. Also restart-safe: the Plugin Hub can now restart it every 10 minutes (change or turn off on the hub's Diagnostics page) so long sessions stay smooth, and settings and progress carry over. Settings files are now saved safely, so a crash can no longer reset them.
